decision: Rejected; production scalar implementation is unchanged.
rationale: Mixed short-input results: Standard8/12 characters and URL16 regressed in median latency. Other cases improved, but shared-VM noise was large and no consistent short-token gain justified increasing decoder tables from512bytes to8192bytes.
candidate: Four position-shifted u32 lookup tables per alphabet; bit31 marks invalid input; 8-character validation/store boundary matches the baseline.
correctness: Compared exact Result error kind/original offset and complete mutated output against baseline. Both alphabets; text lengths0..128 step4 at32 slice offsets with exact output capacity/canaries; all256 bytevalues at each of64 positions, original offset19.
measurement: Both kernels in one executable use the same input/output buffers; fixed seed0x6a09e667f3bcc909;1ms warmup before each sample;7 repetitions, alternating before/after order. All valid, invalid-head, invalid-middle, invalid-tail data retained.
